cross_repository_rule: Quantum-native evidence is created first in the quantum repository. Evidence explicitly tagged TRANSFER_TO_EMK_TENSOR_CELL_DEVICES may be copied into the device repository only after SHA-256 verification. The device repository becomes the canonical home for device-related copies, while the quantum repository retains a compact transfer receipt.

device.role: Device architectures, tensor-cell mappings, device-candidate evidence, hardware interpretations, and transferred quantum evidence relevant to devices.

quantum_classical.role: Quantum circuits, IBM Runtime acquisitions, quantum validation, quantum controls, and quantum-native certificates.
